About
South Stack is a reserve where rolling heathland and farmland meet rugged and rocky sea cliffs. Facing South Stack island and the Irish Sea beyond, the cliffs are a vital breeding ground for Guillemots, Razorbills and Puffins in spring. The rare Chough can be seen swooping along the cliffs all year round.
This Anglesey reserve is home to Ellin’s Tower, a bright white Victorian building that looks a little like a castle. It looks out across the cliffs, down to the lighthouse which stands watch over the seas.
At a glance
Parking
7 Blue Badge spaces. Charges apply all year round. Visitor centre car park is surfaced with tarmac. Two other car parks are crushed, compacted stone. Blue Badge spaces at both Ellin's Tower car park and The Visitor Centre car park. No height restriction. No lighting. No formal drop-off point. Strictly no overnight parking or camping.
Accessible Toilets
Our toilets are open 7 days a week 10am-5pm.
In the Visitor Centre: We have a disabled toilet.
Baby change facilities are available in the ladies toilet and also in the disabled toilet. A separate waste bin is provided for nappy waste.
There are no toilet facilities in Ellin's Tower.
Baby Changing
Baby changing facilities are open 7 days a week 10am-5pm.
Baby change facilities are available in the ladies toilet and also in the disabled toilet. A separate waste bin is provided for nappy waste.
There are no toilet facilities in Ellin's Tower.
Pushchair Accessible
Access paths run from Ellin's Tower car park, follow the level path to the viewpoint outside Ellin's Tower.
A second route between the visitor centre and Ellin's Tower has 25 uneven steps down to Ellin's Tower.
The Coastal trail is more rugged, uneven and narrow.
Wheelchair Accessible
Access paths run from Ellin's Tower car park, follow the level path to the viewpoint outside Ellin's Tower.
A second route between the visitor centre and Ellin's Tower has 25 uneven steps down to Ellin's Tower.
The Coastal trail is more rugged, uneven and narrow.
Toilets
Our toilets are open 7 days a week 10am-5pm
Barbecue
BBQs are a fire risk, endangering other people and the precious wildlife and habitats here. They are not permitted on the reserve at any time.
Dogs
Assistance Dogs only in the Visitor Centre. Dogs are welcome on the reserve and in Ellin's Tower, but aren't allowed inside the cafe.
Please keep your dog under control and stick to the paths. Drinking water is provided for dogs in bowls at the doors of the Visitor Centre and Ellin's Tower.
Assistance Dogs
Assistance dogs are welcome in all parts of the reserve.
Drones
We have a no drones policy in place from 1st March to 31st July.

How you can support South Stack
South Stack Dedication Page
We know that South Stack is a special place for many. If you or your loved one have shared happy memories there, you can make a donation to the reserve on our dedication page. It can be in celebration or in memory, and you can post an image along with your message.

review_note: RSPB supplies reserve habitat, seasonal birds, parking and level viewpoint access. Do not conflate reserve access with admission to the separately operated lighthouse. One actual sourced sight is sufficient for a suggested one-day visit; no three-stop requirement. Do not invent routes, timings, prices or access rights.
